copy.curiosityHook: When mutual attraction sparks inside the guarded compound of a ruthless host, the boundary between leisure and mortal peril begins to dissolve.
copy.description: After twelve years in the Navy, Jay Cochran visits Mexico to unwind at the estate of Tiburon Mendez, a shady and influential businessman. The stay turns precarious when Cochran meets Mendez's captivating wife, Miryea.
copy.vibeSummary: Steamy, suspenseful, and emotionally heavy, moving at a measured pace that demands engaged attention.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Tony Scott, this 1990 thriller blends romantic obsession with looming danger, delivering high-stakes suspense set against an alluring, high-society Mexican backdrop.
